system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003

spatial_coverage.coverage: The Baxie River basin subset of the ASTER GDEM land coverage between 83 degrees north and 83 degrees south.

data_description.temporal_coverage: ASTER Level-1A source scenes acquired from 2000-03-01 to 2013-11-30
data_description.data_format: NASA Earthdata tiled Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF and NetCDF4 collection
data_description.spatial_resolution: 1 arc-second postings (approximately 30 m at the equator)
analytical_capabilities: Derivation of slope, aspect, curvature, and other terrain indices
Watershed, drainage, flow-path, and topographic wetness analysis
Aggregation to coarser grids for multi-scale terrain analysis

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Elevation in meters above the EGM96 geoid
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the DEM layer as terrain elevation in metres. Retain the accompanying NUM layer when available because it records the number of ASTER scenes contributing to each pixel and identifies pixels supplemented from reference DEMs.

data_description.data_source: NASA/METI ASTER GDEM via NASA Earthdata CMR
